components.heading: Section 12. Conditions of Franchise.
components.text: This non-exclusive franchise, grant, and privilege is granted under and subject to all applicable laws and under and subject to all of the orders, rules, and regulations now or hereafter adopted by governmental bodies now or hereafter having jurisdiction. (Ord. 19856 § 12, 10-1-13.)
